tests.title: A request failing several checks answers the status of the earliest failing check
given: a forge handler set with a recording forge stub and recording emitter
an archived workspace owned by another user
a workspace whose origin forge host is unknown
tests.when: write requests are sent that fail combinations of checks: no credential plus bad body; forge:read-only PAT plus missing workspace; non-owner on archived workspace; active owned workspace with malformed JSON and unknown forge; unknown forge with oversized body
then: the statuses are 401, 403, 404, 400 (not active), 400 (invalid request before client resolution), 422 (before 413) respectively
the forge stub received no request in any case
tests.pseudocode: for case in combos: r = send(case.req); assert r.status == case.expected_earliest; assert stub.count == 0

tests.title: A PAT without forge:write, including forge:read only, is refused with 403 on every write route
given: a PAT holding only forge:read
an owned active workspace
tests.when: each of the nine write routes is called with the PAT
then: every answer is 403 with message "PAT requires forge:write scope"
the forge stub received no request
tests.pseudocode: for route in WRITE_ROUTES: r = call(route, pat(['forge:read'])); assert r.status == 403; assert r.msg == 'PAT requires forge:write scope'; assert stub.count == 0

tests.title: An unknown credential type is denied the write scope check
given: an AuthInfo whose CredentialType is "service" injected with apikit.SetAuthInfo
tests.when: a write route is called
then: the answer is 403
the forge stub received no request

tests.title: API keys and admin tokens pass the scope check without permissions
given: an api_key credential with empty permissions and an admin_token credential
an owned active workspace with a forge stub
tests.when: POST /issues is called with each credential
then: neither response status is 401 or 403
the request proceeds to the forge (201)

tests.title: A missing or not-owned workspace answers 404 workspace not found on every write route
given: a workspace owned by another user and a slug that does not exist
tests.when: each write route is called by a non-owner with forge:write for both slugs
then: every answer is 404 with message "workspace not found"
no credential resolution happens and the forge stub received no request

tests.title: An archived workspace answers 400 workspace is not active on every write route
given: an archived workspace owned by the caller
tests.when: each write route is called by the owner with a valid body
then: every answer is 400 with message "workspace is not active"
the forge stub received no request

tests.title: Any hub-side rejection sends no forge request and records no event
given: a forge stub and a recording emitter
tests.when: for any write route and any hub-side rejection class (401, 403, 404, inactive 400, invalid-request 400, workspace_mode_mismatch 400, 422 client resolution, credential error, 413 body_too_large)
then: the forge stub request count is unchanged
the recorded event count is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: for route, rejection in product(WRITE_ROUTES, REJECTIONS): before=(stub.n, em.n); send(route, rejection); assert (stub.n, em.n) == before

tests.title: Writes ignore clone_status and the workspace lock
given: an active workspace with clone_status pending
the workspace lock is held by another operation (wslock.Lock)
tests.when: POST /issues is called with a valid body
then: the status is 201, the same as for a ready unlocked workspace
the call does not block on the lock
tests.pseudocode: unlock = wslock.Lock(slug); r = post('/issues', valid); assert r.status == 201

tests.title: Creating an issue sends the workspace GIT_PAT and never the caller bearer

an API key caller

then: the status is 201 and the body is the issue as issuex encodes it
the stub received Authorization with the GIT_PAT value and not the caller bearer
the unknown field extra caused no error

tests.title: Invalid POST /issues bodies answer 400 naming the field

then: each answer is 400 and the message names title, labels or assignees accordingly

second contains exactly title, state, labels [] and assignees ["a"], and no body key

tests.title: Body length is counted in code points: the limit passes, one more is refused
given: GitHub and GitLab workspaces with stubs
tests.when: for any body-like field, any forge and any code point of 1 to 4 bytes, a string of exactly the limit length and a string of limit+1 length
then: the string at the limit reaches the forge (e.g. 65,536 four-byte characters pass on GitHub)
the string one code point longer answers 413 regardless of byte size
tests.pseudocode: for field, forge, ch in product(FIELDS, FORGES, CHARS): assert send(ch*limit).status != 413; assert send(ch*(limit+1)).status == 413

tests.title: Each forge request of a multi-request operation gets a fresh per-call timeout

tests.title: Event metadata never holds content, credentials or forge messages

forge stubs that echo bodies and tokens in their error messages
